LanguageData.APM_Apparel_MechamancerSuit.label: mechamancer suit
LanguageData.APM_Apparel_MechamancerSuit.description: A power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechmancer suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, providing a personal energy shield and damage resistance comparable to dedicated power armor.
LanguageData.APM_Apparel_ArmorHelmetMechamancerHelmet: A heavy plasteel-weave helmet integrated with mechanoid-coordination systems. Enhances the wearer’s general control over of allied mechanoids, increasing mechanitor bandwidth and command groups while providing moderate protection.
